answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The inlet of work and the ember of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a trellis to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
